name: Ritz Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas Resort
insider_take: This isn't just another city hotel – it's a sprawling 400-acre resort oasis that feels worlds away from Dallas, complete with championship golf and lakefront luxury.
whats_special: The resort sits on the scenic shores of Lake Carolyn and features the TPC Four Seasons Resort Las Colinas golf course, which has hosted PGA Tour events. The property is also home to the largest spa in Texas at 25,000 square feet, and its signature restaurant overlooks the famous Mandalay Canal where you can watch gondola rides glide by.
pro_tip: Book a lake-view room on the higher floors for stunning sunset views, and time your visit during spring when the resort's extensive gardens are in full bloom with native Texas wildflowers.
dont_miss: Take a romantic gondola ride through the Mandalay Canal system, explore the nearby Irving Arts Center, and definitely experience the resort's famous Sunday brunch which features live jazz and panoramic lake views from the terrace.
pros: Luxury resort setting with championship golf course and spa facilities
Exceptional Ritz-Carlton service standards and attention to detail
Convenient Dallas location with easy access to business district and attractions
Elegant accommodations with premium amenities and resort-style atmosphere
cons: Premium luxury pricing typical of Ritz-Carlton properties
Resort location may require transportation to downtown Dallas attractions
